payload.title: Resume a living report by exact Task identity
payload.description:
As an operator, I want a retried optimization attempt to resume the one Report already linked to its Task, so that the Report URL and revision history remain stable regardless of account report volume.

Observed behavior: resume searched only the 500 most recent account Reports. When the existing Task-linked Report fell outside that bounded scan, the service created a second Report for the same Task and restarted revision numbering.

Feature: Task-authoritative living Report resume

Scenario: Existing Report is outside an account scan window
Given a Task already has one linked living Report
And more than 500 newer Reports exist in the account
When the same active optimization attempt resumes
Then the service resolves the Report directly through the Task relationship
And reuses its fixed ReportBlocks and latest revision
And creates no Report or ReportBlock

Scenario: Task has no linked Report
Given a new run Task has no linked Report
When the living report starts
Then exactly one Report and its fixed ReportBlocks are created

Scenario: Conflicting Report identity is observed
Given more than one Report claims the same Task identity
When resume validates the relationship
Then the service fails closed with explicit integrity evidence
And does not silently choose or create another Report

Out of scope: GraphQL schema or resource changes; deleting or rewriting historical Reports.
